headline: Demand intact, while adverse RM movement plays spoilsport

highlights: Demand environment remains strong, particularly across data center, while we expect industrial and export segment to recover further in coming quarters.

Due to product mix as well as continued high RM prices, we cut our estimates by 13%/9%/8% for FY27/28/29 to factor in lower gross margin for FY27, while we expect margin to improve subsequently as projects taken at lower commodity prices get completed over time.
Overall demand thesis remains intact and we expect that in a few quarters, full impact of price hikes, completion of older orders, as well as operational efficiencies will start playing out.
In-line revenue; miss on profitability KKC’s 2QFY27 revenue was in-line with our estimates, while lower-than- expected margin led to miss on profitability.
valuation: We reiterate a BUY rating on KKC with a revised TP of INR5,600 based on 45x P/E for Dec’28 estimates (INR6,200 earlier).

Valuation and outlook We cut our estimates by 13%/9%/8% for FY27/28/29 to factor in lower gross margin for FY27, while we expect it to improve subsequently as projects taken at lower commodity prices get completed over time.
The stock is currently trading at 39.2x/32.8x P/E on FY28/FY29 estimates.
watch: However, going ahead, we expect the company to benefit from opportunities across construction, rail, mining, marine, and compressors, with government infrastructure spending and tender-led projects, thereby providing a key growth avenue.
However, we expect a sequential improvement in exports, supported by a gradual recovery in global demand and continued opportunities across key markets.
